newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul stocks close shade higher in active trading.
newsitem.headline: Seoul stocks close shade higher in active trading.

text.p: South Korean stocks finished Saturday's half-day session slightly higher after late selling wiped out most of the early gains, brokers said.
They said selling increased as the index broke through the 700-point barrier. The index closed up 3.01 points at 696.95, off a session high of 701.11.
"Investors appeared fearing a big downward correction once the market rises too much in a short period," said a Hyundai Securities broker.
Stocks that fell on Friday on rumours of financial troubles ended off their session lows on bargain hunting.

Jinro Ltd recovered from a fall to its daily limit to close down 500 won at 10,200 as bargain hunting emerged. Its affiliate Jinro Industries, which fell to its limit on Friday, went limit-up to 5,840 won by adding 430 won.
Chipmakers fell on profit-taking after early gains. Samsung Electronics ended 300 won lower at 62,600. Hyundai Electronics Industries was down 800 won to 39,600.
